main_theorems.label: Theorem 1.1
statement_components: One complex open neighborhood V of the entire nonnegative ell2 action quadrant and an analytic extension of the physical renormalized KdV Hamiltonian to V.
The bilinear Hilbert gradient agrees coordinatewise with the existing KdV frequencies minus 8*pi^3*n^3 on V intersect V0.
Gradient at zero is zero and its full bounded derivative is -6 times identity.
An analytic local diffeomorphism near zero on complex ell2.
One positive radius, chosen before I and J, for the real Hessian bound d2H(I)[J,J] <= -norm(J)^2 on nonnegative ell2 actions, for every real ell2 direction J.
main_theorems.domain: Positive-index actions (I_n) for n >= 1; nonnegative includes zero coordinates; original Hkdv on weighted ell^(3,1)_+.
main_theorems.topology: Norm topology on complex ell2; open ambient extension around every cone point.
remaining: Construct the actual original coordinatewise analytic physical KdV frequency family on an ell^(-1,1) neighborhood V0, with physical recovery. Apply the proved common-domain continuation bridge to finish the full V intersect V0 identity. This is the remaining essential component of main Theorem 1.1.
Complete main Theorems 1.2-1.3 on Fourier-Lebesgue Birkhoff coordinates and physical KdV well-posedness.

main_theorems.label: Theorem 1.2
statement_components: For every real s in [-1/2,0] and every finite p >= 2, the same global H^-1 KdV Birkhoff map restricts to a real analytic diffeomorphism from L_0^(s,p) onto ell_0^(s+1/2,p).
main_theorems.domain: Real, mean-zero periodic distributions; two-sided complex sequence coordinates with z_0=0 and z_-n=conj(z_n).
main_theorems.topology: Fourier-Lebesgue and weighted sequence Banach norm topologies; not weak-star endpoints.
remaining: Fourier-Lebesgue spectral asymptotics and analytic restriction
Surjectivity by action reduction, plus inverse regularity

main_theorems.label: Theorem 1.3
statement_components: For every s in [-1/2,0] and every finite p >= 2 the KdV initial value problem is globally C0 well-posed on the real mean-zero Fourier-Lebesgue space L_0^(s,p).
main_theorems.domain: All real initial data in L_0^(s,p), all real times; solutions interpreted through the distributional H^-1 framework referenced by the paper.
main_theorems.topology: Continuity of trajectories and dependence on initial data in the Fourier-Lebesgue norm, compatible with the H^-1 solution notion.
main_theorems.proof_note: Presented in the introduction as an immediate application of Theorem 1.2 and the previously constructed KdV frequency/solution theory; no separately labelled proof later.
remaining: Physical KdV frequency reality and coordinate continuity
Conjugation of sequence phase flow by the same physical KdV Birkhoff map
Agreement/uniqueness with accepted H^-1 distributional solution theory

high_energy_pair_progress.endpoint_limit_scope: At every actual high radicand zero, for real continuous potentials on a common complex neighborhood and cutoff, from both nonreal energy half-planes; no simplicity assumed. Literal values at excluded branch points not asserted.
high_energy_pair_progress.unqualified_action_bound_scope: Global physical H^-1/Birkhoff actions; still open.

arnold_action_comparison_progress.zero_locus: classicalHillHighContourAction n a = 0 iff l = u for the actual high pair

L2_whole_gap_square_progress.square_family_quantifiers: For each q and each B>0, choose r>0, N>0 and a complex L2-open V containing q before every n>=N. One K_n is jointly analytic on a neighborhood of the entire closed energy disc times V, with norm(K_n)<B.

L2_whole_gap_square_progress.actual_source_primitive_matching: K_n=(hillL2ContinuedPrimitive+i*n*pi)^2 at every source-admissible point of the disc times V

L2_whole_gap_square_progress.high_pair_data: Actual unordered energy zeros, exact Multiset(l,u) multiplicities, parity trace levels, analytic energy midpoint and squared gap; unique up to exchange.

L2_uniform_moment_family_progress.quantifiers: One positive cutoff N and complex L2-open V containing q precede all nearby a in V, all n>=N and all shell points.

Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.potential_space: WeightedCoeff (Weight.sobolev (-1)) 2, full complex space in its H^-1 norm
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.Fourier_normalization: Unit-period coefficients; derivative symbol 2*pi*i*k. A later periodDouble is needed when entering the ambient period-two Hill model.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.kernel_smallness: The inverse-symbol coefficient sequence kappa_m tends to zero in ell2 as m tends to infinity.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.actual_quadratic_term: Raw coefficients are the absolutely convergent sums sum_j v_(k-j)*w_j; Young ell2*ell2 -> ellInfinity and the inverse bracket give H^-1 membership.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.fixed_point_method: Banach contraction on a complete closed ball, with C*R<=1/4; the derivative of id+B(x,x) is a unit, giving analytic open inverse charts.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.uniform_bounded_ball_quantifiers: For every B>=0 there is M such that for all m>=M and all complex H^-1 q with norm(q)<=B there are v with norm(v)<=4*B+1, an open U containing q, and an analytic s:U->L2 with s(q)=v and s(r)' +(m+1)*s(r)+s(r)^2=r for every r in U.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.L2_image_regularity: Any L2 v whose actual shifted Miura image is L2 has one full Sobolev derivative. The proof first obtains ell^(4/3), then Young gives v*v in ell2, and the derivative graph recovers H1.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.exact_energy_translation: u=s(q)+(m+1)/2, so Miura(u)=q+(m+1)^2/4, with the constant inserted as the zeroth Fourier mode.

Hminus1_discriminant_progress.potential_space: All complex WeightedCoeff (Weight.sobolev (-1)) 2 in the H^-1 norm; original unit-period Fourier convention.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.L2_physical_comparison: Delta_Hminus(periodOneL2Inclusion(q),lambda)=hillL2Discriminant(periodDouble(q),lambda), for every complex unit-period L2 q and every complex energy.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.Miura_chart_energy_shift: (m+1)^2/4, inserted as the zeroth Fourier coefficient; energy is translated by the same constant.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.L2_Miura_trace_construction: The original diagonal canonical NLS trace is even in frequency by the physical H1 Miura identity and H1 density in L2. Cauchy-circle entire even descent gives joint energy/L2 analyticity.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.overlap_scope: All complex energies, every point of every open overlap, independent of mass and inverse branch; proved by physical L2 matching and density.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.source_continuation_domain: Open domain where lambda is in the complex slit plane and Delta(s*q,lambda)^2-4 is nonzero for every real 0<=s<=1.

Apply it at sqrt(z^2+c), transfer the free trace, fill each full disc by maximum modulus, then use compactness for source paths.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.actual_shifted_primitive_imaginary_strip: abs(Im(F+i*n*pi))<pi/2 on every admissible point of the full high quarter-pi disc.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.whole_disc_scope: One r>0, N>0 and complex H^-1-open V precede all n>=N; K_n is jointly analytic on the full closed energy disc E_n(r) times V, where E_n(r) has center (n*pi)^2 and radius n*pi*r.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.whole_square_zero_set: K_n=0 iff Delta_Hminus^2-4=0 on the full energy disc times V.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.whole_square_source_matching: K_n=(F+i*n*pi)^2 at every source-admissible point of the energy disc times V.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.joint_indexed_branch_limits: F tends to -i*n*pi in joint energy/H^-1 topology through every source-admissible direction at every actual branch point in the full high discs, including multiple zeros.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.comparison_bounds: norm(K_n+ (sqrt(lambda)-n*pi)^2)<=epsilon*r^2 and norm(K_n+(lambda-(n*pi)^2)^2/(4*(n*pi)^2))<=epsilon*r^2 on the full energy discs.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.root_confinement_proof: At a trace root Delta^2=4, four*norm(sin(z))^2<=five*epsilon for trace error epsilon<=1. The existing filled-sine quotient gives uniform small displacement.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.full_source_energy_shells_covered: For each rho>0, one N and complex H^-1-open V cover every rho*n<=norm(lambda-(n*pi)^2)<=n at every n>=N. Nonempty shells have rho<=1.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.actual_Arnold_period: A_n=hillHminusHighContourMoment n 0=-(1/pi)*integral_energy_circle F, center (n*pi)^2 and radius n.

Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.potential_space: Full complex unit-period PeriodOneHminusOne, with no real, mean-zero or regularity hypothesis.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.common_neighborhood_quantifiers: For every complex H^-1 potential q, there exist one complex H^-1-open V containing q, N>0 and C>0, before every a in V and every positive n>=N.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.quadratic_comparison_tolerance_scope: For each 0<epsilon<=1/16, a single V,N yield comparison by epsilon*r^2 and actual two-root data at every high index. V,N may depend on epsilon.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.pair_uniqueness_proof: The smaller concentric disc gives a submultiset of the larger with the same cardinality two. Exact analytic multiplicities force equality, including repeated roots.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.quotient_scope: Analytic on the complete closed energy disc, nonzero throughout the open disc, globally exact factorization K=(lambda-lambda_minus)*(lambda-lambda_plus)*Q.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.quotient_uniform_bound: norm(Q)<=4/(n*pi*r)^2 on the full closed energy disc.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.normalized_quotient: norm(4*(n*pi)^2*Q+1)<=epsilon on the complete closed disc.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.normalized_energy_analytic_unit_root: H^2=Q, H nonzero, norm(H-i/(2*n*pi))<=epsilon/(2*n*pi). Joint potential analyticity of the chosen unit root is not asserted.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.period_normalization: A_n=-(1/pi)*integral F; R_n=(1/pi)*integral (F+i*n*pi)^3 on the actual radius-n energy circle.

common_action_family_descent_progress.scope: General analytic descent and the exact KdV-weighted positive-ell2 extension mechanism; physical KdV coordinate/invariance inputs remain explicit and unproved.
common_action_family_descent_progress.raw_action_formula_for_normalized_coordi: I_k=(x_k^2+y_k^2)/(2*w_k); for the KdV base action weight w_k=(1+positive_index(k))^(-1).
common_action_family_descent_progress.exact_summand_factor: 8*n*pi, n:PNat, with positive factor divided out only after simultaneous descent of the weighted terms.
common_action_family_descent_progress.positive_ell2_domain: The actual inverse image under baseActionInclusion of one constructed complex open neighborhood of the full weighted nonnegative action cone.
common_action_family_descent_progress.real_isospectral_invariance_hypothesis: Equality of the full actual entire discriminant at two real H^-1 potentials; action-fiber/discriminant identification is still unproved.

Hminus1_real_spectral_progress.potential_space: Every real unit-period H^-1 potential, specified by conjugate reflection of its raw Fourier coefficients.
Hminus1_real_spectral_progress.zero_persistence_hypotheses: A jointly continuous family of entire scalar functions, a dense parameter subset, and a non-identically-zero limit slice. Rouché controls an isolated zero disc; multiple zeros are included.
Hminus1_real_spectral_progress.reflection_sign: R(conj lambda,q)=-conj R(lambda,q), F(conj lambda,q)=-conj F(lambda,q).

Hminus1_physical_cut_progress.potential_space: Every real unit-period H^-1 potential, with conjugate reflection of the raw Fourier coefficients; no mean-zero hypothesis.
Hminus1_physical_cut_progress.generic_cubic_sign_hypotheses: An analytic filled square, nonnegative real values along the entire cut, and strict expanding/contracting root signs on the two half-discs. Collapsed cuts use bounded removability.

actual_cubic_action_normalization_progre.exact_weighted_contour_summand_coefficie: 8*pi*n*R_n=I_n^2*L_n with L_n analytic at zero and L_n(0)=-3.

physical_Hilbert_Taylor_and_local_conseq.exact_action_ray: I(gamma(t))=t^2*v, gamma(t) tends to the real zero Hminus1 source
physical_Hilbert_Taylor_and_local_conseq.finite_support_contour_ray_limit: H(t^2*v)/(t^2)^2 tends to -3*sum_n v_n^2 for every positive finite-support v
physical_Hilbert_Taylor_and_local_conseq.full_bounded_gradient_derivative_at_orig: -6*Id on the original positive-index complex ell2 space, including infinite-support directions
physical_Hilbert_Taylor_and_local_conseq.full_Hilbert_quadratic_Taylor_remainder: Hstar(a)+3*sum_n a_n^2=O(norm(a)^3) in the complex ell2 norm
